svg.title: Concept B, The Ledger Room
svg.text: GENERAL LEDGER OF A PAYMENT NETWORK · FOLIO 1
Every merchant an account; every dependency a standing entry, inferred from
payment history alone. Post a shock, and the books must reconcile.
Folio 1. Tie-out of standing entries. Each line is an inferred dependency: a shortfall at the account on the left
passes to the account on the right. In red, the entries of the five keystone accounts.
m0070 never receives ₹53.05 L from m0008, due at hour 19.
Receivable from m0008 due, not received
Memo: m0070 first constrained, 108.4 h after the shock
The same week, twice, with the same random draws
✓ Reconciled: the replay agrees with the snapshot exactly.
Delay is a scenario parameter, not a production timing.
At 48 h nothing is kept on time, yet the cut is 20.9 %: the payments are still late, but less late (97 % of it).
Across the 8 benchmark scenarios with a plan, the mean cut as chosen falls from 17.4 % [5.4, 30.7] at 0 h to 7.9 % [2.6, 15.7] at 48 h.
Synthetic network. Every figure is replayed offline inside the synthetic generator; ₹ are analytic rupees in Indian grouping; the disruption index is unitless.
